term.gujarati: વિદ્યુત પ્રવાહની ઉષ્મીય અસર (Vidyut Pravahni Ushmiya Asar)
term.hindi: विद्युत धारा का तापीय प्रभाव (Vidyut Dhara Ka Tapiya Prabhav)

definition.simple: When electricity flows through a wire, it makes the wire hot, just like how rubbing your hands together makes them warm.
definition.academic: The production of heat in a conductor when an electric current passes through it, due to the resistance offered by the conductor.

examples: Electric Iron used for pressing clothes

common_misconceptions: Heat is created out of nothing; actually, electrical energy is converted into heat energy.
All wires get equally hot; actually, it depends on the material's resistance.
ai_context.tutor_hint: Ask the student what happens when they run fast for a long time. They get hot, right? The same thing happens when electrons 'run' through a wire that makes it hard for them to move.
